name: Grille
author: E. T. Carter
description: Two line gratings laid over one another at a slight angle — bold coloured bars beating into broad moiré fringes that sweep as the pair turns, bright welds flaring where the lines coincide. Crisp, kinetic, op-art.

params.label: Line frequency
params.effect: How tightly the lines are spaced; low is bold bars, high a fine comb.

params.label: Skew
params.effect: Angle between the two gratings; this sets the moiré fringe scale — 0 aligns them, larger fans the fringes.

params.label: Spin
params.effect: Rotation speed of the whole pair; 0 holds the fringes still.

params.label: Line weight
params.effect: Thickness of the bars; low is thin lines on dark, high is dark gaps between fat bars.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer tilts the second grating; 0 ignores the mouse.
